title: probe-image-size before 7.5.0 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability in lib/parse_stream/avif.js that…
description: probe-image-size versions before 7.5.0 have an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability in the lib/parse_stream/avif.js component. This flaw allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service by supplying an AVIF stream or URL with attacker-declared ftyp or meta box sizes that are excessively large. The parser buffers all received bytes based on these declared sizes, leading to memory exhaustion.
